content.text:
Oracle Cites ‘Force Majeure’ to Shield Itself on Controversial Data Center: Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that Oracle sent a force-majeure notice to the Project Jupiter developer, a Blue Owl unit, seeking to preserve payment-deferral rights if the campus missed its 2028 target. The report did not include the notice itself. (time=2026-09-24T12:25:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Oracle sends force majeure notice on its New Mexico Stargate data center: TechCrunch explicitly identified Bloomberg as the first reporter. It repeated the notice’s reported payment-deferral purpose and reported Oracle’s planned-schedule position and Blue Owl’s statement that financial commitments were unchanged. (time=2026-09-24T18:11:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Oracle moves to shield itself from AI buildout risks: Axios quoted Oracle’s vice president saying Jupiter remained on its planned schedule and that force-majeure notices alone do not establish a delay or change delivery expectations. It also reported Blue Owl’s statement that financial commitments were unchanged. (time=2026-09-24T21:03:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
